evidence.raw_text: Document Name: Privileged Access Review Record. Reference: SEC-AC-07 Rev.3. Review Notes: The procedure requires quarterly privileged-access reviews. Records for the first three quarters were available. The fourth-quarter review was completed two weeks late, and its management approval record was not available during the audit. The audit scope was limited to privileged user accounts.
